title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.00270v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. translated_title: 面向神经组合优化的几何自监督预训练
translated_abstract: 神经组合优化（NCO）技术已成为解决旅行商问题（TSP）等路由问题的传统精确算法的高效替代方案。然而，当扩展到高维实例时，这些基于强化学习模型的泛化能力受到严重限制。在其他领域，如计算机视觉和自然语言处理中，通过采用自监督预训练策略已缓解了这一问题。尽管如此，将其应用于缺乏超出二维空间坐标的复杂拓扑属性的路由图仍然是一个挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种专门设计用于捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布的几何自监督预训练框架。通过应用等距变换，如旋转和轴向反射，模型学习到稳健的结构表征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种几何自监督预训练框架，通过等距变换增强神经组合优化模型的泛化能力，以应对高维路由问题中的空间不变性和距离分布挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework that enhances generalization in neural combinatorial optimization via isometric transformations, addressing spatial invariance and distance distribution challenges in high-dimensional routing problems.
